crossRefs.note: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will…
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…
They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no…

translations.web: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.
translations.bsb: and they took him and threw him into the pit. Now the pit was empty, with no water in it.
translations.kjv: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water
translations.asv: and they took him, and cast him into the pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
